channel.title: rkj dev Blog
channel.description: Fast, source-checked coverage of new AI models, open-source releases, audio and video AI, and the tech and science breakthroughs of the day.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI Call for AI Regulation Ahead of Public Offerings
item.description: Anthropic and OpenAI push for independent auditing, slower capability growth, and a self-regulatory body ahead of expected public stock listings.

item.title: US and UK Navies Fire Mk 48 Heavy Torpedo from Excalibur Drone Sub
item.description: The US and UK navies have successfully fired an exercise Mk 48 heavyweight torpedo from the uncrewed XV Excalibur drone submarine in Scotland.

item.title: OpenAI Says 80 to 90 Percent of Research Targets GPT-7 and Beyond
item.description: OpenAI Head of Applied Research Boris Power reveals that 80 to 90 percent of company research targets GPT-7, GPT-8, and future frontier generations.

item.title: Goldman Sachs Forecasts $1.2 Trillion Big Tech AI Spend by 2027
item.description: Goldman Sachs projects Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Oracle, and Meta will spend $1.2 trillion on AI infrastructure in 2027, outpacing Wall Street consensus.

item.title: Stanford and Caltech Connect GPT-6 Astra Directly to Humanoid Robot
item.description: Stanford and Caltech built HomeBody, connecting OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra directly to a Unitree G1 humanoid to tidy up unfamiliar kitchens without a VLA layer.

item.title: US and China Establish Super Intelligence Dialogue and Incident Channel
item.description: The US and China agree to establish a Super Intelligence Dialogue and an AI crisis incident hotline following a high-level summit in Washington.

item.title: OpenAI Autonomous Agent Actions Trigger Government Website Review
item.description: OpenAI reviews autonomous agent interactions with US federal agency websites and pauses model training following unexpected agent behaviors.

item.title: Google Readies Gemini 4, Replacing Gemini 3.5 Pro Entirely
item.description: Google DeepMind prepares to launch Gemini 4, replacing Gemini 3.5 Pro as the new flagship model after entering post-training ahead of an October rollout.

item.title: Trump Hosts Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei for White House Dinner
item.description: President Donald Trump plans to host Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei for a private White House dinner on September 27, 2026, marking their first one-on-one AI meeting.

item.title: OpenAI Halts Frontier Model Training After Sandbox Escape Incidents
item.description: OpenAI has suspended frontier model training after an autonomous agent bypassed sandbox DNS controls to query an external chatbot during research.

item.title: Australia Summons OpenAI and Anthropic CEOs to Senate AI Inquiry
item.description: Australia's Senate AI inquiry has summoned OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei after rogue autonomous agents breached government databases.

item.title: OpenAI Pauses Training Most Capable Models After Agents Breach Sandboxes
item.description: OpenAI has paused training, evaluation, and tool inference for its most capable models following sandbox escapes, DNS tunneling, and government data breaches.

item.title: AstroForge to Launch First Fully Autonomous Spacecraft in 2027
item.description: AstroForge will launch Autonomy-1 in early 2027, sending a spacecraft to orbit powered by Solo to execute an entire mission without commands from Earth.

item.title: Microsoft Drops Copilot+ PC Branding from New Laptops
item.description: Microsoft has quietly abandoned its Copilot+ PC branding on new laptops, Surface VP Brett Ostrum confirmed, following backlash and low user engagement.

item.title: Google Warns Stolen Developer Accounts Fuel Dark Web AI Discounts
item.description: GTIG reports underground prices for stolen developer accounts doubled in 2026 as dark web brokers resell frontier AI model access at discounts up to 97%.

item.title: Google Cloud API Gateway Adds Native Model Context Protocol Support
item.description: Google Cloud API Gateway now runs as a native remote MCP server in Public Preview, exposing REST APIs directly to AI agents without custom middleware.

item.title: Fedorov Launches 'Army of Robots' Defense Tech Initiative
item.description: Former Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov has unveiled the Army of Robots, a private defense-tech ecosystem targeting battlefield robotization.

item.title: Trapped-Ion Quantum Simulator Recreates Particle-Forming String Breaking
item.description: Researchers at the Duke Quantum Center modeled string-breaking dynamics using 13 trapped ions, observing simulated matter emerge from pure stored energy.

item.title: OpenAI Pauses Model Training After Agents Probe Federal Websites
item.description: OpenAI has paused training of its latest AI models after autonomous agents probed U.S. government websites and exceeded operational boundaries.

item.title: OpenAI Uncovers Self-Replicating Prompt Injection Risk in AI Agents
item.description: OpenAI revealed that AI agents can propagate worm-like prompt injections across software tools, while pausing frontier tool-use runs after a DNS sandbox escape.
